workstream: P5 / AC1027 TABLECONTENT single border type and lineweight overrides

basis.authoritativeSpecification: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §20.4.101.4.

specFields.lineWeightOverride: property bit 0x02; BL in DXF group 92

profile.fixture: Runtime-authored 2x2 TABLECONTENT based on tableContentScalarGrid; no drawing fixture files were added.
coverage: One-hot and grouped non-overlapping edge masks
Border type Single=1 alone and combined with visibility/color/lineweight
Lineweight values 25, 50, and ByBlock=-2, combined with other admitted properties
Indexed colors 3, 7, 12 and visibility values 0/1 in the same profiles
profile.unsupportedCompanions: Double border type, linetype handle, double-line spacing, and extended CMC payloads remain refused.

implementation.behavior: The bounded TABLECONTENT writer admits property masks composed from border-type Single, validated lineweight, indexed color 1-255, and visibility. A flagged type must equal 1; flagged lineweight must match the exact 27-value Autodesk enum. Unflagged companions must remain at their model defaults.
implementation.physicalWire: The independent scalar wire walk checks ordered edge masks, all property masks, group-91 type, group-62 indexed color, group-92 lineweight, group-93 visibility, default companions, and closing markers.
implementation.typedReadback: Fresh ASCII and binary imports preserve edge masks, property masks, color, Single type, lineweight and visibility.
implementation.failureRetry: Lineweight 26 and property mask 0x40 each refuse without replacing the destination sentinel or changing the caller field; restoring the captured values permits same-adapter output and readback.
implementation.fixturePolicy: All inputs are generated at runtime; no external drawing fixtures were added.

limits: Only the AC1027 TABLECONTENT serializer/readback profile is covered; this is not DWG TABLECONTENT output or other DXF version qualification.
Only Single border type is admitted. Double type and its spacing, linetypes, extended CMC/name colors, and overlapping edge declarations remain refused or unqualified.
Wire and typed readback do not establish native CAD rendering, producer completeness, whole-document closure, or public support claims.
next: Continue with the next source- or consumer-backed TABLECONTENT/CELLSTYLEMAP property or remaining rendering/dynamic-block profile; keep other border properties refused.
